newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Low offer in Nepal kero tender from Vitol, $199.37.
newsitem.headline: Low offer in Nepal kero tender from Vitol, $199.37.

text.p: The lowest offer in state-owned Nepal Oil Corp's (NOC) superior kerosene import tender was made by Dutch trader Vitol at $199.37 per tonne for July 1-10 delivery, cost-and-freight (c-and-f) Indian east coast, traders said on Wednesday.

An NOC source said the company's board will decide on the award this evening as well as consider issuing another tender to buy a similar volume of 30,000 tonnes of kerosene for July 21-31 delivery, c-and-f east coast.
The board will also consider issuing a tender to buy 30,000 tonnes of high speed diesel for August delivery, he said.
The NOC source said the current kerosene tender attracted about 10 offers.
Traders here said the next best offer was made by Swiss trader Glencore at $203.40 per tonne, c-and-f.
In its last tender for May 1-10 delivery, Nepal purchased 30,000 tonnes of kerosene from Japan's Mitsubishi Corp at $204 per tonne, c-and-f east coast.
Nepal awarded its previous 0.5-percent sulphur diesel import tender to Shell Singapore at $185.73 per tonne, c-and-f Indian east coast for June 1-10 delivery.
